basic.shortTooltip: Zul'jin Channels to regenerate Health over time

heroic.name: Taz'dingo!
heroic.fullTooltip: For the next <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> Health. Taz'dingo!
heroic.shortTooltip: Become unkillable

heroic.name: Guillotine
heroic.fullTooltip: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">330 (+4% per level)</c> damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.
heroic.shortTooltip: Deal heavy area damage

trait.name: Berserker
trait.fullTooltip: Activate to increase Basic Attack damage by 25% but consume 2% maximum Health per attack.Passive: Zul'jin attacks 1% faster for every 1% of maximum Health missing.You Want Axe?Quest: Every 5 Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 1.Reward: After attacking Heroes 75 times, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.Reward: After attacking Heroes 150 times, Twin Cleave now revolves twice.Lose 3 stacks on death.

activable.name: Amani Rage
activable.fullTooltip: Activate to cause Zul'jin to instantly lose <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> of his current Health and heal for that amount over <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> seconds.
activable.shortTooltip: Activate to lose Health and restore it over time

level1.name: Boneslicer
level1.fullTooltip: Grievous Throw now pierces through all enemies hit and restores <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> Mana per Hero hit. Additionally, Grievous Throw's mark is no longer removed by Basic Attacks.

level1.name: Recklessness
level1.fullTooltip: While Zul'jin is below <c val="bfd4fd">75%</c> Health, he gains <c val="bfd4fd">10%</c> Spell Power. While he is below <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> Health, his Basic Attack damage is increased by <c val="bfd4fd">10%</c> and Basic Attacks against Heroes grant an additional stack of You Want Axe?.

level1.name: Headhunter
level1.fullTooltip: Quest: Zul'jin's first Takedown against each enemy Hero permanently increases his damage dealt by 2.5%.Reward: After getting Takedowns on every enemy Hero, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.
level1.shortTooltip: <c val="e4b800">Quest:</c> Takedowns increase damage

level4.name: Troll's Blood

level16.name: No Mercy!

level16.shortTooltip: Basic Attacks ignore Armor, deal more damage
